title: Top K Frequent Elements
statement: Return the k values that occur most often, in any order. The answer is guaranteed unique.
constraints: k is between 1 and the number of distinct values
hints: Start with a Dictionary of value to occurrence count.
Then you need the k largest counts. Sorting the distinct values by count is acceptable.
For linear time: bucket by count, since no count can exceed nums.Length, then read buckets from the top down.
complexity: O(n log n) with sorting, O(n) with bucketing
